audit.why: 7.5/10 TRICKY at 52.79% over 358 games fits a lane you lose early and own from level 3 onward, and the shipped chart says exactly that (Quinn 1-2 and 6, K'Sante 3-5 and both item stages). Full and content layers agree row for row and the packet chart agrees on the shape, so no flip is proposed.

Spikes are in the right order. The number behind the level-6 row is that Behind Enemy Lines has a 3-second cooldown at 700 range — it is a travel and roam tool she can re-enter constantly, not a fight ultimate, which is why 6 belongs to her map pressure rather than to a duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind is attributed to the wrong ability on the entire page. Vault (E) 'dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed ... briefly interrupting it' — it slows and interrupts, it does not blind. The blind is Blinding Assault, her Q, thrown from 1025 range on an 11s cooldown. The page says 'her E vault blind' or 'E vault knocks you back and blinds your autos' in five places. Also 'a fully charged W is unstoppable and CC-immune' — Riot's text for Path Maker says only 'charges up, taking reduced damage'; neither unstoppable nor CC immunity is in the kit. And 'your R recall pulls her out of position' — All Out has no recall; it knocks the target back through a wall and dashes after them.
audit.why: A player told the blind is on her dash will hold their autos for the wrong cast and eat the real one, and a player told Path Maker is CC-immune will charge it into her Vault interrupt expecting to power through — Vault explicitly interrupts.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault (Q, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1025 range) is the blind. Vault (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 675 range) dashes in, slows, briefly interrupts you, and leaps her back to attack range — that is her disengage and the cooldown to bait. Heightened Senses (W) is a 50s-at-rank-1 reveal, not a combat tool. Path Maker's charge reduces damage taken; All Out knocks back and launches through a wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Behind Enemy Lines can be interrupted.
audit.why: Riot's text has Quinn and Valor 'fly around at great speed' as a channelled state, and the flagged missing interaction confirms it is a channel. Your Ntofo Strikes pull and Path Maker stun cancel it — that is how you stop the roam this page keeps warning about, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Written into dosFull[2].d: her R is a channel, and your Q pull or W stun ends it.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are hers — her E vault knocks you back and blinds your autos, and Harrier procs poke you while you only have Q and no way to close. Don't walk up to throw Q3 at her; she just E-vaults out and resets with move speed. Last-hit at max Q range, eat the poke, and wait for Level 3. Once your Q-W combo is online you have a real answer: a fully charged W is unstoppable and CC-immune, so it punches through her E knockback if you read her vault.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are hers — Blinding Assault blanks your autos from 1025 range and Vault leaps her back out, while Harrier procs poke you and you have no way to close. Don't step up for a Q stack you can't finish; she just Vaults off and resets with move speed. Last-hit at max Q range, eat the poke, and wait for Level 3. Once your combo is online you have an answer: Path Maker's charge cuts the damage and stuns her if you read the vault.

edits.before: With your first item you're durable enough that her poke and E burst stop mattering — Iceborn slow plus your Q stacks glue her in place so she can't kite. From 2+ items you're a teamfight monster: she's a squishy roamer with no escape once you commit, and your R recall pulls her out of position to your team. She has no percent-HP or true damage to punish your armor, so unlike Vayne or Fiora she never reclaims this — just don't get caught facechecking her roams.
edits.after: With your first item you're durable enough that her poke and Vault burst stop mattering — Iceborn's slow plus your Q stacks glue her in place so she can't kite. From 2+ items you're a teamfight monster: she's a squishy roamer with no escape once you commit, and All Out knocks her back through a wall into your team. She has no percent-HP or true damage to punish your armour, so unlike Vayne or Fiora she never reclaims this — just don't facecheck her roams.
